subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Tell 12-hour time in hours, half hours and quarter hours

show.line: The long hand points to three. It has gone a quarter of the way round. Quarter past two!

rounds.prompt: Which clock shows quarter past five?
rounds.praise: Yes! Long hand on three, short hand just past five.

rounds.prompt: Look at the clock. What time is it? Say the time.
Where does the long hand point at quarter past?
rounds.praise: Yes! The long hand points to three.

rounds.prompt: Is this clock half past or quarter past? Tap the words.
Four o'clock, quarter past four, half past four. What comes next?
rounds.praise: Quarter to five! Then five o'clock.

rounds.prompt: Which clock shows quarter to seven? The long hand points to nine.
rounds.praise: Yes! Quarter to seven. Nearly seven o'clock.

hints: Long hand on three means quarter past. Long hand on nine means quarter to.
The short hand shows which hour it has just passed.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this clock.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: The long hand is on three. It is half past eight!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Long hand on three is quarter past. Quarter past eight.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. Long hand on three, short hand past eight. Quarter past eight!

parent_line: Can read quarter past and quarter to on a clock with hands.
